# Indi Gupte

> Personal site of Indi Gupte, from West London: brand, partnerships and research at RiskMandate, working every day with a team of AI agents, and looking for work experience. Contact: LinkedIn only, https://www.linkedin.com/in/indi-gupte-26960b318 (no email address or phone number is published).

Site version: __VERSION__. Facts come from Indi's LinkedIn profile and a post he wrote in a UK Web Summit WhatsApp group, both read 2026-11-18, and from the public records linked below. Quotes are his words as written. Nothing here should be taken as more than these sources say.

## Now
- Brand and Partnerships Lead, RiskMandate.ai, November 2026 to present.
- Operations Manager, SportsHealing Ltd, September 2026 to present.
- Working with OmKneeHealth, a London health startup making knee treatment simpler (https://kneelens.com).

## What he built (Web Summit, November 2026)
- RiskMandate: Agent Behaviour Policies, "a record of what each AI agent can reach, what it's allowed to do, and the gap between the two." https://riskmandate.ai
- PrompTugal.news: "a newsroom mapping AI in Portugal, run by people and AI agents together." He is one of its three editors. https://promptugal.news
- Lisbon Tech Fringe: "when Storm Charles cancelled Wednesday, we built a guide to the side events, and an app, the same day." https://lisbontechfringe.com
- Strangers in the Loop, RiskMandate's second song, produced by Indi Gupte. Source: https://newsroom.sgit.ai/articles/every-hour-is-twenty-years.md
- The team's business cards, which he designed.

## How he works
- A team of 27 AI agents, 23 running (https://web-summit.sgit.ai/people/indi/index.md).
- 277 commits by his agents on the team's site (https://newsroom.sgit.ai/articles/ten-days-at-web-summit.md).
- Web Summit team role: "The message, outreach, and the factory of examples" (https://web-summit.sgit.ai/team/indi/index.md).
- In his words: "What I bring: company research, design (I designed our business cards), and working every day with a team of AI agents."

## Languages
- Speaks English, Italian and French.
- An interest in Sanskrit, and the same interest in programming languages.
- Working through Harvard's CS50x; builds software as a junior developer for three health technology startups.

## Background
- Harrow School, September 2021 to June 2026.
- Harrow Diploma, University of Buckingham, May 2026.
- Education as his profile lists it: University of Oxford, Modern Languages, Italian and Portuguese (2027). His summary says he will read Modern Languages and International Relations at university from next autumn.
- Volunteered in hospitals in London and rural Italy: a lasting interest in medicine, and a pull towards diplomacy, "where languages, judgement and tact meet".
- Top skills: web design, web development, debating.

## Looking for
- Work experience.
- Glad to talk to people working in languages, AI, medicine or diplomacy.
